guide: Earn the other 54 trophies first — the Platinum pops automatically once the last one lands.
No separate task: work through the 54 below and this one follows.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing as Jason.
Story trophy — unlocks naturally and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story.
Story trophy — unlocks naturally.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story.
Story trophy — unlocks naturally. The asterisks are in the game's own title.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the story.
Story trophy — unlocks naturally.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

guide: Complete Chapter 4 of the story.
Story trophy — unlocks naturally.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

guide: Complete the final story mission.
After the credits, free roam stays open for cleanup — nothing is locked away.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run.
Story trophy — unlocks naturally.
trophies.name: Trust

guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist.
Story trophy — unlocks naturally.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play.
Story trophy — unlocks naturally.
trophies.name: Family Matters

guide: Complete the story mission Headliners.
Story trophy — unlocks naturally.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown.
Story trophy — unlocks naturally.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory.
Story trophy — unlocks naturally.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist, which opens after the story.
You do not need literally everything: 15 of 18 card sets and 70 of 80 challenges count toward it.
Check Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion. Hardest trophy in the game — expect 200+ hours.
trophies.name: A Long Road

guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind across Leonida.
Stunt types: Stunt Jumps (130), Under the Bridges (202), Knife Flights (40), Base Jumps (25) — 397 in total, you need just over half.
Track at Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts; spots are on the map at Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, and a stunt.
One attempt each is enough — no wins required.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
Two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero).
Most challenges have three difficulty tiers; some unlock only after other conditions — check the map.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations.
Some locations charge an entry fee.
Locations are at Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.
trophies.name: Top Fun

guide: Win 20 different races.
Re-winning the same race does not count — each win must be a different race.
Track at Touch Pad > Activities > Racing; most locations let you hire a car, so mind the car Rating.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
Early in the game Cal asks for a Parrotfish over 2kg — fish the marked area until one bites.
You need a boat with a rod; hijack one nearby if you do not own one.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

guide: Complete an arcade game.
Any arcade cabinet in Leonida counts — finish one full game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
guide: Complete all of Andy's story missions, ending with Puff Puff Pass.
Stranger strand — the trophy pops on Andy's final mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
guide: Complete Kenton's final mission, Maritime Disputes.
Finish Kenton's strand.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
guide: Complete Billy's final mission, Hometown Heroes.
Finish Billy's strand.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
guide: Complete 8 qualifying Stranger mission strands across Leonida.
Only some side questlines count; they stay available after the story.
Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, and Tyrone are five of them.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
guide: Complete all of Randy's missions, ending with his final mission.
Randy's Wish List vehicles are part of the strand — collect the vehicles he asks for.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
guide: Complete all of Tyrone's missions, ending with his final mission.
The Kitty Litter Lab locations help you progress this strand.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.flag: possibly missable — one spot is in Chapter 1
guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida.
A meditation only counts once the final zen animation plays.
POSSIBLY MISSABLE: one spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — meditate there before the story moves on.
Track at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
Bret's strand — take down the unique animal he marks.
trophies.name: Fair Game

guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets.
There are 18 sets in Leonida; any 3 full sets count.
100% completion needs 15 sets, so this pops on the way. Cards can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count.
Track at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up).
Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), and Sculptures (23) all count, plus No Flusher Tags.
Track at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

guide: Complete 50 Challenges.
There are 80 Challenges in the game; 70 are needed for 100% completion.
View them at Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
Play with your partner beside you, raise 4 stars, then break line of sight and escape.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
Chain three shop robberies in one run with your partner — do not let the Wanted Level drop between them.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

guide: Discover 100 vehicles.
You discover a vehicle by getting inside it or scanning it.
Track at Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
Wait for a group of 5 or more, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
Steal a plane at Vice City International Airport and take off without a flight plan.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

guide: Get into a Rhino tank and cause mayhem.
Find a Rhino at a military site or at a high Wanted Level, then stay hot in it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
Go in quiet — no alarms, no one spotting you — and get out clean.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape.
Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4; there are 8 vaults, and 100% needs all 8.
Escape after each vault — the trophy counts completed escapes.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
Ambush an armored truck on the road, crack it, grab the cash, and lose the heat.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

guide: Explore all of Leonida.
Visit every named region of the state — the map fills in as you go.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
Hit one illegal operation per gang across Leonida.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
Buy a cocktail at a beach bar on Ocean Beach and take in the view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
Drive a car through the showroom glass and out the other side.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.flag: unconfirmed — guides disagree on the method
guide: A partnership with mass appeal.
UNCONFIRMED: guides disagree — PowerPyx says max Strength on both characters; Push Square says max body fat. Method not confirmed yet.
trophies.name: Personal Best

guide: Choices made (for better or worse).
Make a key story choice — the trophy pops on a decision point in the campaign.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

guide: Second time's the charm.
Fail a specific moment once, then succeed on the retry.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

guide: What the hell just happened?
UNCONFIRMED: a hidden oddity event — the method is still being confirmed by guides.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
Perform a melee drive-by elimination — strike from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
Launder Marked Bills through your contacts — the total is cumulative.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops.
Cumulative across every shop — clothes, weapons, food, and more all count.
Find shops at Touch Pad > Style.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

guide: Purchase all garage properties.
Buy all 8 garages via the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone ($160,000 total).
Garages: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue $12,000; Vela Rota Drive $24,000; Persistence Road $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court $34,000; Atlantic Court $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
Register vehicles at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop — you need empty parking spots.
Scooter Bros delivers registered vehicles to you for a small fee.
trophies.name: On the Spot
